SINF.description: Plate Elements for Influence Surface (SINF). A single global record whose ELEM_LISTS field enumerates the plate element numbers designated for influence surface analysis; the write path clears all existing SINF elements then re-adds each element number in the list.

ELEM_LISTS.description: List of plate element numbers assigned to the influence surface. On write, all existing SINF entries are deleted and every element number in this list is added; an empty list clears the assignment.
